description.value: Arrowsmith Bikes is a full-service bicycle retailer with locations in Nanaimo and Parksville carrying major brands including Trek, Giant, Liv, and Santa Cruz across mountain, gravel, e-bike, hybrid, and kids categories. Their in-house service department staffs professionally trained mechanics who handle everything from minor adjustments to comprehensive overhauls, with documented specialist expertise in several e-bike drivetrain systems. The shop stocks a broad accessories range including bags and racks, lights, locks, and nutrition supplies that touring cyclists will find useful.

address.value: 4300 Wellington Road, Unit 202, Nanaimo, BC V9T 2H3

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content was successfully fetched and is extensive, confirming Arrowsmith Bikes is an active full-service bicycle retailer with two Vancouver Island locations. The service page explicitly confirms professional mechanics handle repairs from minor adjustments to full overhauls, and details e-bike service capability for specific drivetrain brands (Bosch, Fazua, Shimano, Giant, TQ). OSM phone and address both corroborate with website content.
